title: Protocol for characterizing the inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 infection by a protein of interest in cultured cells
protocol: Remove the cell culture media from Caco-2-N cells.
Wash Caco-2-N cells with 5 mL sterile PBS when they are grown in monolayer configuration and at 90% confluence.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 2 mL trypsin 0.25% EDTA solution to the cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 2–5 min.
Resuspend the cells with 2 mL of complete DMEM media.
Pipette the media with cells up-and-down using a 10 mL pipette.
Collect the cell suspension in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Take an aliquot of 10 μL of cell suspension for counting.
Mix the 10 μL cell suspension aliquot with 10 μL trypan blue solution.
Transfer the 20 μL mixture into a cell counting slide.
Count live cells manually with a hemocytometer or automated cell counter to determine the cell density.
Prepare the cell culture media by mixing 450 μL of stock cells with 4,050 μL of culture media.
Seed 250 μL of cell suspension per well in a new 48-well plate.
Incubate cells for 18–24 h at 37°C in a CO2 (5%) incubator to allow cells to recover and attach.
Reconstitute SARS-CoV-2 ΔN trVLP infection media by adding viral stocks into complete DMEM cell culture media.
Prepare different concentrations of a protein of interest (e.g., MUC1) for treating trVLP.
Aspirate the cell culture media.
Add 250 μL of different MUC1-trVLP mixtures respectively into each well as planned.
Culture the cells at 37°C in 5% CO2.
Incubate the cells for 96 hours.
Collect supernatant from Caco-2-N cells.
Add 250 μL of sterile PBS to wash the cells.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 250 μL of Buffer RL1 containing 1% V/V β-mercaptoethanol to lyse the cells.
Collect the cell lysate into RNase-free Microcentrifuge Tubes for RNA extraction.
Add Buffer RL2, Buffer RW1, and Buffer RW2 according to manufacturer's instructions.
Add 100 μL of RNase-free ddH2O to extract, purify, and obtain RNA.
Add RNA and primer to each PCR tube on ice.
Prepare a premix in the indicated order and add 8 μL of premix to each tube containing respective RNA and primer.
Mix gently and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 65°C for 5 minutes.
Chill on ice, spin down and place back on ice.
Incubate for 5 minutes at 25°C for random hexamer primed synthesis.
Incubate at 42°C for 60 minutes.
Terminate the reaction by heating at 70°C for 5 minutes.
Set up a 96-well plate according to the manufacturer’s instructions for the 2× PowerUpTM SYBR Green Master Mix.
Load the 96-well plate with the appropriate reagents and samples as per the protocol.
Prepare PCR mixture for each well using SARS-CoV-2-RNA-F, SARS-CoV-2-RNA-R, RPS11-F, and RPS11-R primers.
Mix the components thoroughly in a premix if making ahead of time.
Centrifuge the prepared premix briefly to remove air bubbles.
Transfer the appropriate volume of each reaction to each well of an optical plate.
Seal the optical plate with MicroAmp™ Optical Adhesive Film.
Centrifuge the sealed plate briefly to eliminate any air bubbles.
Set up and run the qRT-PCR instrument according to manufacturer’s guidelines.
Set the thermal cycling conditions using default PCR parameters specified in the table for the instrument.
Analyze data to determine the infection ratio and inhibition effects.
Test MUC1's inhibitory activity against SARS-CoV-2 infection.
Denature MUC1 by heating at 100°C for 10 minutes to serve as a mock control.
Use human breast milk sample A17, which has been shown to inhibit SARS-CoV-2 effectively, at a concentration of 2 mg/mL.
Calculate the relative expression and inhibition rate compared to the negative control.
Characterize the protein of interest in different stages of viral infection process: attachment, entry, and post-entry stage.
Use specific temperature sets to restrict viral infection into certain stages.
Prepare three groups of culture media designed as follows:
Dilute trVLP infection stock 10 times for Group 1.
Mix trVLP infection stock diluted 10 times with 0.002 mg/mL of MUC1 for Group 2.
Mix trVLP infection stock diluted 10 times with 2 mg/mL of A17 for Group 3.
Place each group in a solution and incubate at 4°C for 1 hour.
Add the MUC1-trVLP mixtures to the wells for infection.
Incubate the plates at 4°C for 2 hours to allow viral attachment to cells.
Wash the cells with 300 μL PBS per well, repeating three times.
Shake the plates gently after adding PBS to better remove free trVLP.
Reload each well with 250 μL of culture media and continue culturing for 96 hours.
Dilute trVLP with complete DMEM cell culture media to MOI=1.
Add the viral media into the wells.
Incubate plates in a refrigerator at 4°C for 2 hours.
Wash the cells with PBS three times.
Prepare fresh media only.
Prepare fresh media with 0.002 mg/mL of MUC1.
Prepare fresh media with 2 mg/mL of A17.
Add each group of media into the wells respectively.
Incubate plates in an incubator at 37°C for 1 hour.
Wash the cells with PBS three times.
Reload fresh media and culture for 96 hours.
Harvest the cells for analysis.
Detect viral mRNA using qRT-PCR.
Dilute the trVLP with complete culture media to achieve a MOI of 1.
Add the diluted trVLP into the wells.
Incubate at 37°C for 2 hours.
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Prepare fresh media as follows:
Mix fresh media only.
Mix fresh media with 0.002 mg/mL of MUC1.
Mix fresh media with 2 mg/mL of A17.
Add the prepared media to respective wells.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 96 hours.
Harvest the cells.
Extract viral RNA from harvested cells.
Measure extracted RNA by qRT-PCR.
Calculate antiviral ability based on qRT-PCR results.
Seed Caco-2-N cells one day prior to viral infection.
Dilute trVLP stock 10 times.
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times) with MUC1 at a concentration of 0.002 mg/mL.
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times) with heparin at a concentration of 100 U/mL.
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times), MUC1 (0.002 mg/mL), and heparin (0.1 U/mL).
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times), MUC1 (0.002 mg/mL), and heparin (1 U/mL).
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times), MUC1 (0.002 mg/mL), and heparin (10 U/mL).
Mix trVLP (diluted 10 times), MUC1 (0.002 mg/mL), and heparin (100 U/mL).
Incubate the mixtures at 4°C for 2 hours.
Discard the media from the wells.
Wash cells with PBS three times, using 300 μL per well.
Replenish cells with fresh media and incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment for 96 hours.
Collect supernatant from the cells.
Harvest the cells to extract RNA.
Quantify viral RNA by qRT-PCR.
